2609.01341.title: Probing Factual Knowledge Transfer with Training Data Interventions
2609.01341.paper_summary: Do multilingual language models transfer factual knowledge across languages during continued pretraining, or do they mostly recall facts learned directly from the target-language data? To answer this question more reliably, we propose an intervention-based framework: starting from an English-pretrained model, we continue pretraining on Persian data from which specific facts have been systematically removed at varying levels of granularity. We construct SIFT, a resource of 500 triples across 20 relations, stratified by the cultural origin of each fact's subject into general (globally prominent) and Persian-related entities, designed for both systematic fact removal from training data and evaluation, with natively written Persian cloze templates. Our results show that fact transfer is very limited: under the strictest removal condition, a large majority of English-acquired facts fail to transfer into Persian. We further show that sentence-level co-occurrence removal is insufficient to eliminate fact signal, and that easier (randomly selected) negative candidate sets substantially inflate apparent transfer by rewarding shallow associative heuristics, while performance on a harder candidate set that allows for less reliance on heuristics is much lower. Finally, we show that source-language entity frequency has a large influence, with Persian-related facts, which are orders of magnitude rarer in the English corpus, hardly transferring.
2609.01341.paper_summary_zh: 多語言模型在持續的預訓練過程中是否能夠跨語言轉移事實知識，還是主要從目標語言數據中直接回憶學到的事實？為了更可靠地回答這個問題，我們提出了一個基於干預的框架：從一個英語預訓練模型開始，我們在波斯語數據上繼續預訓練，這些數據中已系統性地移除了特定事實，並在不同的細節層次上進行了調整。我們構建了SIFT，這是一個包含500個三元組的資源，涵蓋20個關係，根據每個事實主體的文化來源劃分為一般（全球知名）和與波斯相關的實體，旨在系統性地從訓練數據中移除事實並進行評估，並附有本地撰寫的波斯語填空模板。我們的結果顯示，事實轉移非常有限：在最嚴格的移除條件下，絕大多數從英語獲得的事實無法轉移到波斯語。我們進一步顯示，句子級別的共現移除不足以消除事實信號，而更簡單（隨機選擇）的負候選集顯著膨脹了表面轉移，因為它獎勵了淺層的聯想啟發式，而在一個更難的候選集上，表現則要低得多，因為它對啟發式的依賴較少。最後，我們顯示源語言實體頻率有很大影響，與波斯相關的事實在英語語料庫中稀缺數量級，幾乎無法轉移。
